parts.text:
Found a real bug: `AiHistoryManager.aiWorkspaceDir` (lines 78-84) duplicates workspace resolution logic from `AiWorkspace.root()` and uses `File(ext, "../../Yomikai/AI").canonicalFile` — which resolves relative to app external files dir, i.e. `/storage/emulated/0/Android/data/<pkg>/files/../../Yomikai/AI` = `/storage/emulated/0/Android/Yomikai/AI` — NOT `/storage/emulated/0/Yomikai/AI`. So history files go into a *different* directory than the rest of the workspace. That's a genuine inconsistency. Let me verify: `getExternalFilesDir(null)` = `/storage/emulated/0/Android/data/<pkg>/files`. Then `../../Yomikai/AI` → `/storage/emulated/0/Android/data/<pkg>/files/../../Yomikai/AI` = `/storage/emulated/0/Android/Yomikai/AI`. Meanwhile `AiWorkspace.root` uses `Environment.getExternalStorageDirectory()/Yomikai/AI` = `/storage/emulated/0/Yomikai/AI`. So yes — different folder. That's a real bug worth reporting: history/plans are not in the workspace folder shown in settings, and `zip_workspace` won't include the history.

Also `AiWorkspace.Skill.openIntent` uses `toShareIntent` rather than an "open" intent — comment says "открыть" but implementation shares. Minor.

Also `AiSkills.openIntent` name says open but uses share intent — semantics mismatch (documented as "показать его в галерее/читалке" but sends a share sheet).

Let me continue reading the remaining files. Let me read AiHttpServer, AiCapabilityReporter, AiGithub, ZenProtocol, ZenAvailability.

389:         val MAX_SIZE = 40 * 1024 * 1024L
390:         return try {

392:             conn.connectTimeout = 15_000
393:             conn.readTimeout = 60_000
394:             conn.instanceFollowRedirects = true
395:             conn.connect()
396: 
397:             if (conn.responseCode !in 200..299) {
398:                 return BooksStore.ImportResult.Failure("HTTP ${conn.responseCode}")
399:             }
400: 
401:             // Проверяем Content-Length до чтения
402:             val contentLength = conn.contentLengthLong.takeIf { it > 0 } ?: -1
403:             if (contentLength > MAX_SIZE) {
404:                 conn.disconnect()
405:                 return BooksStore.ImportResult.Failure("Файл слишком большой (${contentLength / 1024 / 1024} МБ, лимит 40 МБ)")
406:             }
407: 
408:             // Потоковое чтение с проверкой размера
409:             val baos = java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream()
410:             val buffer = ByteArray(8192)
411:             var totalRead = 0L
412:             conn.inputStream.use { input ->
413:                 while (true) {

415:                     if (read < 0) break
416:                     totalRead += read
417:                     if (totalRead > MAX_SIZE) {
418:                         conn.disconnect()
419:                         return BooksStore.ImportResult.Failure("Файл больше 40 МБ")
420:                     }
421:                     baos.write(buffer, 0, read)
422:                 }

256:             val total = conn.contentLengthLong.takeIf { it > 0 } ?: (m.sizeMb * 1048576L)

281:                 }
282:                 part.delete()
283:                 false
284:             } else {

286:             }
287:         } catch (e: Exception) {
288:             logcat(LogPriority.WARN, e) { "LLM download failed: ${m.id}" }
289:             part.delete()
290:             false
291:         } finally {
292:             conn?.disconnect()

295:         }

318:     /**

336:     /** Локальный чат: полностью офлайн-ответ установленной моделью. */

338:         runCatching<String> {
339:             error("Локальный LLM-движок удалён из сборки для уменьшения размера APK")
340:         }.onFailure {
341:             logcat(LogPriority.WARN, it) { "Local LLM chat failed" }
342:         }.getOrNull()
343:     }
344: 
345:     fun unload() {
346:         runCatching { engine?.close() }
347:         engine = null
348:         engineModelId = null
349:     }

351:     /**
352:      * ЭКСПОРТ модели в tar.xz для других приложений: реальный Apache
353:      * commons-compress + XZ (LZMA2, preset 6 — баланс скорость/сжатие).
354:      * Квантованные веса дожимаются на ~20-40%. Файл кладётся в
355:      * workspace AI-агента (/sdcard/Yomikai/AI), откуда его можно
356:      * «Поделиться» в любое приложение.
357:      */
358:     suspend fun exportTarXz(context: Context, m: Model, onProgress: (Float) -> Unit = {}): File? =
359:         withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
360:             val src = fileOf(context, m)
361:             if (!src.isFile) return@withContext null
362:             runCatching {
363:                 val outFile = File(AiWorkspace.root(context), "export/${m.id}.tar.xz")
364:                 outFile.parentFile?.mkdirs()
365:                 val total = src.length().toFloat()
366:                 XZOutputStream(FileOutputStream(outFile), LZMA2Options(6)).use { xz ->
367:                     TarArchiveOutputStream(xz).use { tar ->
368:                         tar.setLongFileMode(TarArchiveOutputStream.LONGFILE_POSIX)
369:                         val entry = TarArchiveEntry(src, src.name)
370:                         tar.putArchiveEntry(entry)
371:                         FileInputStream(src).use { input ->
372:                             val buf = ByteArray(1 shl 20)
373:                             var done = 0L
374:                             while (true) {
375:                                 val n = input.read(buf)
376:                                 if (n < 0) break
377:                                 tar.write(buf, 0, n)
378:                                 done += n
379:                                 onProgress(done / total)
380:                             }
381:                         }
382:                         tar.closeArchiveEntry()
383:                     }
384:                 }
385:                 outFile
386:             }.onFailure {
387:                 logcat(LogPriority.ERROR, it) { "LLM export failed" }
388:             }.getOrNull()
389:         }
390: }

parts.text:
Big finding: `LocalLlm` engine is removed from the build. So:
- `ensureEngine` always returns null (lines 304-316)
- `probe` always returns false (lines 324-334)
- `chat` always returns null via `error(...)` (lines 337-343)
- `AiCapabilityReporter` hardcodes local LLM as unavailable (lines 72-76)
- Yet the whole LocalLlm UI (download catalog, progress, export tar.xz) may still be exposed in settings. Need to check where LocalLlm is referenced in UI. That's ~dead code surface. Also `LocalLlm.kt` imports MediaPipe-related things? No—imports are commons-compress. But dependency on commons-compress + xz may exist in build.gradle for the export only. Worth noting.

Also `AiHttpServer` security issue: `respond` sets `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *` (line 466) while auth is via `?key=` query param. And the page HTML at line 509 loads images with key in URL. CORS `*` means any website could read responses if the key is known... but the key is required. Still, a DNS-rebinding/CSRF concern: any malicious web page could POST to `http://<phone>:8765/chat?key=...` but doesn't know key. However the `?key=` in the URL is logged... Minor. More important: `AiHttpServer` binds `0.0.0.0` (line 68) — exposes to whole LAN. And there's no rate limiting; each request spawns a thread (line 75) — unbounded thread creation from a LAN client = DoS. Also `POST /chat` uses `runBlocking` (line 144) on a raw thread — acceptable but blocks a thread for potentially minutes (`soTimeout = 180_000`).

Also note: `AiHttpServer` `GET /file` reads the whole file into memory (line 345 `f.readBytes()`) — potential OOM for large workspace files (e.g., a multi-GB model file in workspace). Similarly `/books/cover` reads cover bytes. And `importBookFromUrl` buffers whole file into `ByteArrayOutputStream` up to 40 MB (line 409-423) — comment says "потоковое чтение (без OOM)" but then calls `BooksStore.importBytes(context, fileName, baos.toByteArray())` — so it does hold the whole 40 MB in memory, twice (byte array + copy). So the "streaming (no OOM)" claim is inaccurate.

Let me now read RunnerLlm, ZenProtocol, ZenAvailability, DocExporter.

113:     /**
114:      * Запуск новой сессии: dispatch workflow → ожидание артефакта endpoint
115:      * (обычно 2-4 минуты: скачивание модели в ранер). [onStatus] — живые
116:      * статусы для UI. null при ошибке/отсутствии токена.
117:      */
118:     suspend fun startSession(
119:         context: Context,
120:         modelKey: String,
121:         onStatus: (String) -> Unit,
122:         os: String = "linux",
123:     ): Session? = startSessionInternal(context, modelKey, "", onStatus, os)

125:     private suspend fun startSessionInternal(
126:         context: Context,
127:         modelKey: String,
128:         customUrl: String,
129:         onStatus: (String) -> Unit,
130:         os: String = "linux",
131:     ): Session? = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
132:         val token = prefs().githubPat().get()
133:         if (token.isBlank()) {
134:             onStatus("Нет GitHub-токена: задайте его в настройках вкладки AI (⚙)")
135:             return@withContext null
136:         }
137:         val selectedOs = if (os == "windows") "windows" else "linux"
138:         val session = Session(
139:             id = "s" + System.currentTimeMillis().toString(36) + (1000..9999).random(),
140:             model = modelKey,
141:             os = selectedOs,
142:         )
143: 
144:         onStatus("Отправляем запуск в GitHub Actions…")
145:         val dispatchBody = JSONObject()
146:             .put("ref", "main")
147:             .put(
148:                 "inputs",
149:                 JSONObject()
150:                     .put("model", modelKey)
151:                     .put("session", session.id)
152:                     .put("custom_url", customUrl)
153:                     .put("os", selectedOs),
154:             )
155:         val dispatch = runCatching {
156:             githubRequest(
157:                 token = token,
158:                 url = "https://api.github.com/repos/$REPO/actions/workflows/$WORKFLOW/dispatches",
159:                 method = "POST",
160:                 body = dispatchBody.toString(),
161:             )
162:         }.getOrElse {
163:             onStatus("Не удалось связаться с GitHub: ${it.message ?: "ошибка сети"}")
164:             return@withContext null
165:         }
166:         if (dispatch.code !in 200..299) {
167:             onStatus("GitHub отклонил запуск (${dispatch.code}): ${apiError(dispatch.body)}")
168:             return@withContext null
169:         }
170: 
171:         // Workflow dispatch не возвращает id запуска. Находим ровно наш run по
172:         // уникальному session id, затем читаем только ЕГО job и артефакты.
173:         // Это устраняет гонку старой реализации с глобальными 20 артефактами.
174:         val deadline = System.currentTimeMillis() + START_TIMEOUT_MS
175:         var lastStatus = ""
176:         var runId: Long? = null
177:         while (System.currentTimeMillis() < deadline) {
178:             val state = fetchRunState(token, session.id, selectedOs)
179:             runId = state.runId ?: runId
180:             if (state.message != lastStatus) {
181:                 onStatus(state.message)
182:                 lastStatus = state.message
183:             }
184: 
185:             // Endpoint публикуется до долгого keep-alive шага. Ищем его в
186:             // конкретном run, поэтому параллельные ранеры больше не мешают.
187:             runId?.let { id ->
188:                 fetchEndpointArtifact(token, id, session.id)?.let { endpoint ->
189:                     session.url = endpoint.first
190:                     session.apiKey = endpoint.second
191:                     session.terminalUrl = endpoint.third.ifBlank { null }
192:                     saveSession(context, session)
193:                     onStatus("✅ Сессия готова: ${endpoint.first}")
194:                     return@withContext session
195:                 }
196:             }
197: 
198:             // Раньше failure/cancelled молча проглатывались, и приложение все
199:             // восемь минут показывало ожидание. Теперь ошибка шага видна сразу.
200:             if (state.terminal) {
201:                 onStatus(state.message)
202:                 return@withContext null
203:             }
204:             delay(POLL_INTERVAL_MS)
205:         }
206:         onStatus(
207:             if (runId == null) {
208:                 "Таймаут: GitHub не создал запуск за ${START_TIMEOUT_MS / 60_000} минут"
209:             } else {
210:                 "Таймаут: endpoint не появился за ${START_TIMEOUT_MS / 60_000} минут. " +
211:                     "Последний статус: ${lastStatus.ifBlank { "неизвестен" }}"
212:             },
213:         )
214:         null
215:     }

329:     /** Скачать артефакт video-<session> и вернуть первый mp4 внутри. */
330:     private fun fetchVideoArtifact(token: String, runId: Long, sessionId: String): VideoResult? {
331:         return runCatching {
332:             val response = githubRequest(
333:                 token,
334:                 "https://api.github.com/repos/$REPO/actions/runs/$runId/artifacts?per_page=100",
335:             )
336:             if (response.code !in 200..299) return null
337:             val artifacts = JSONObject(response.body).getJSONArray("artifacts")
338:             var downloadUrl: String? = null
339:             for (i in 0 until artifacts.length()) {
340:                 val artifact = artifacts.getJSONObject(i)
341:                 if (
342:                     artifact.getString("name") == "video-$sessionId" &&
343:                     !artifact.getBoolean("expired")
344:                 ) {
345:                     downloadUrl = artifact.getString("archive_download_url")
346:                     break
347:                 }
348:             }
349:             val url = downloadUrl ?: return null
350:             val zip = githubDownload(token, url)
351:             if (zip.code !in 200..299 || zip.body.isEmpty()) return null
352:             var out: File? = null
353:             ZipInputStream(zip.body.inputStream()).use { zis ->
354:                 var entry = zis.nextEntry
355:                 while (entry != null) {
356:                     if (!entry.isDirectory && entry.name.endsWith(".mp4")) {
357:                         val bytes = zis.readBytes()
358:                         if (bytes.size >= 1024) {
359:                             out = File.createTempFile("yomi_video_", ".mp4")
360:                                 .apply { writeBytes(bytes) }
361:                             break
362:                         }
363:                     }
364:                     entry = zis.nextEntry
365:                 }
366:             }
367:             out?.let { VideoResult(it, it.length()) }
368:         }.getOrNull()
369:     }

384:     /**
385:      * GET/POST GitHub API с таймаутами и чтением тела ошибки.
386:      * Ходит через прокси приложения (Настройки → Сеть), как и AI-чат:
387:      * раньше раннеры молча игнорировали прокси и не работали там, где
388:      * прямой доступ к api.github.com заблокирован.
389:      */
390:     private fun githubRequest(
391:         token: String,
392:         url: String,
393:         method: String = "GET",
394:         body: String? = null,
395:     ): GithubResponse {
396:         val conn = AiAssistant.openConnection(url) as HttpURLConnection
397:         try {
398:             conn.requestMethod = method
399:             conn.connectTimeout = 15_000
400:             conn.readTimeout = 30_000
401:             conn.setRequestProperty("Authorization", "Bearer $token")
402:             conn.setRequestProperty("Accept", "application/vnd.github+json")
403:             conn.setRequestProperty("X-GitHub-Api-Version", "2022-11-28")
404:             conn.setRequestProperty("User-Agent", "Yomihon-Runner")
405:             if (body != null) {
406:                 conn.doOutput = true
407:                 conn.setRequestProperty("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
408:                 conn.outputStream.use { it.write(body.toByteArray()) }
409:             }
410:             val code = conn.responseCode
411:             val stream = if (code in 200..299) conn.inputStream else conn.errorStream
412:             return GithubResponse(code, stream?.use { it.readBytes().toString(Charsets.UTF_8) }.orEmpty())
413:         } finally {
414:             conn.disconnect()
415:         }
416:     }

418:     /** Скачивание бинарного артефакта с безопасным проходом GitHub redirect. */
419:     private fun githubDownload(token: String, initialUrl: String): BinaryResponse {
420:         var currentUrl = initialUrl
421:         repeat(5) {
422:             val url = URL(currentUrl)
423:             // Redirects ведут на внешнее хранилище артефактов — напрямую, без прокси.
424:             val viaProxy = url.host == "api.github.com"
425:             val conn = if (viaProxy) {
426:                 AiAssistant.openConnection(currentUrl) as HttpURLConnection
427:             } else {
428:                 url.openConnection() as HttpURLConnection
429:             }
430:             try {
431:                 conn.instanceFollowRedirects = false
432:                 conn.connectTimeout = 15_000
433:                 conn.readTimeout = 30_000
434:                 conn.setRequestProperty("Accept", "application/vnd.github+json")
435:                 conn.setRequestProperty("User-Agent", "Yomihon-Runner")
436:                 // Не отправляем PAT на внешний release-assets/blob storage.
437:                 if (url.host == "api.github.com") {
438:                     conn.setRequestProperty("Authorization", "Bearer $token")
439:                     conn.setRequestProperty("X-GitHub-Api-Version", "2022-11-28")
440:                 }
441:                 val code = conn.responseCode
442:                 if (code in setOf(301, 302, 303, 307, 308)) {
443:                     currentUrl = conn.getHeaderField("Location")
444:                         ?: return BinaryResponse(code, ByteArray(0))
445:                 } else {
446:                     val stream = if (code in 200..299) conn.inputStream else conn.errorStream
447:                     return BinaryResponse(code, stream?.use { it.readBytes() } ?: ByteArray(0))
448:                 }
449:             } finally {
450:                 conn.disconnect()
451:             }
452:         }
453:         return BinaryResponse(310, ByteArray(0))
454:     }

460:     /** Реальный статус выбранной job; failure/cancelled являются терминальными. */
461:     private fun fetchRunState(
462:         token: String,
463:         sessionId: String,
464:         os: String,
465:         workflow: String = WORKFLOW,
466:         stepText: (String) -> String? = ::llmStepText,
467:     ): RunState {
468:         return runCatching {
469:             val runsResponse = githubRequest(
470:                 token,
471:                 "https://api.github.com/repos/$REPO/actions/workflows/$workflow/runs" +
472:                     "?event=workflow_dispatch&per_page=20",
473:             )
474:             if (runsResponse.code !in 200..299) {
475:                 return RunState(message = "GitHub API ${runsResponse.code}: ${apiError(runsResponse.body)}")
476:             }
477:             val runs = JSONObject(runsResponse.body).getJSONArray("workflow_runs")
478:             var run: JSONObject? = null
479:             for (i in 0 until runs.length()) {
480:                 val candidate = runs.getJSONObject(i)
481:                 if (candidate.optString("display_title").contains(sessionId)) {
482:                     run = candidate
483:                     break
484:                 }
485:             }
486:             val foundRun = run ?: return RunState(message = "⏳ Запуск принят, ждём ранер GitHub…")
487:             val runId = foundRun.getLong("id")
488:             val runStatus = foundRun.optString("status")
489:             val runConclusion = foundRun.optString("conclusion")
490:             if (runStatus == "queued" || runStatus == "waiting" || runStatus == "pending") {
491:                 return RunState(runId = runId, message = "⏳ Ранер в очереди GitHub…")
492:             }
493: 
494:             val jobsResponse = githubRequest(
495:                 token,
496:                 "https://api.github.com/repos/$REPO/actions/runs/$runId/jobs?per_page=20",
497:             )
498:             if (jobsResponse.code !in 200..299) {
499:                 return RunState(
500:                     runId = runId,
501:                     terminal = runStatus == "completed",
502:                     message = "GitHub jobs API ${jobsResponse.code}: ${apiError(jobsResponse.body)}",
503:                 )
504:             }
505:             val jobs = JSONObject(jobsResponse.body).getJSONArray("jobs")
506:             val wantedName = "serve-$os"
507:             var job: JSONObject? = null
508:             for (i in 0 until jobs.length()) {
509:                 val candidate = jobs.getJSONObject(i)
510:                 if (candidate.optString("name") == wantedName) {
511:                     job = candidate
512:                     break
513:                 }
514:             }
515:             if (job == null) {
516:                 for (i in 0 until jobs.length()) {
517:                     val candidate = jobs.getJSONObject(i)
518:                     if (candidate.optString("conclusion") != "skipped") {
519:                         job = candidate
520:                         break
521:                     }
522:                 }
523:             }
524: 
525:             val selectedJob = job
526:             val completed = runStatus == "completed" || selectedJob?.optString("status") == "completed"
527:             val conclusion = selectedJob?.optString("conclusion").orEmpty().ifBlank { runConclusion }
528:             val steps = selectedJob?.optJSONArray("steps")
529:             if (completed) {
530:                 var failedStep = ""
531:                 if (steps != null) {
532:                     for (i in 0 until steps.length()) {
533:                         val step = steps.getJSONObject(i)
534:                         if (step.optString("conclusion") in setOf("failure", "cancelled", "timed_out")) {
535:                             failedStep = step.optString("name")
536:                             break
537:                         }
538:                     }
539:                 }
540:                 val detail = when (conclusion) {
541:                     "cancelled" -> "запуск отменён"
542:                     "timed_out" -> "превышен лимит времени"
543:                     "success" -> "job завершилась до публикации endpoint"
544:                     else -> "ошибка запуска"
545:                 }
546:                 return RunState(
547:                     runId = runId,
548:                     terminal = true,
549:                     message = "❌ $detail" +
550:                         failedStep.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }?.let { " • шаг: $it" }.orEmpty() +
551:                         " • run #$runId",
552:                 )
553:             }
554: 
555:             if (steps != null) {
556:                 for (i in 0 until steps.length()) {
557:                     val step = steps.getJSONObject(i)
558:                     if (step.optString("status") == "in_progress") {
559:                         val name = step.optString("name")
560:                         val text = stepText(name) ?: name
561:                         return RunState(runId = runId, message = "▶ $text")
562:                     }
563:                 }
564:             }
565:             RunState(runId = runId, message = "▶ Ранер запускается…")
566:         }.getOrElse {
567:             RunState(runId = null, message = "Временная ошибка статуса: ${it.message ?: "сеть"}")
568:         }
569:     }

571:     /** Человекочитаемые статусы этапов llm-runner.yml. */
572:     private fun llmStepText(name: String): String? = when {

593:     /** Ищет endpoint только внутри нужного run, скачивает zip и читает JSON. */
594:     private fun fetchEndpointArtifact(
595:         token: String,
596:         runId: Long,
597:         sessionId: String,
598:     ): Triple<String, String, String>? {
599:         return runCatching {
600:             val response = githubRequest(
601:                 token,
602:                 "https://api.github.com/repos/$REPO/actions/runs/$runId/artifacts?per_page=100",
603:             )
604:             if (response.code !in 200..299) return null
605:             val artifacts = JSONObject(response.body).getJSONArray("artifacts")
606:             var downloadUrl: String? = null
607:             for (i in 0 until artifacts.length()) {
608:                 val artifact = artifacts.getJSONObject(i)
609:                 if (
610:                     artifact.getString("name") == "endpoint-$sessionId" &&
611:                     !artifact.getBoolean("expired")
612:                 ) {
613:                     downloadUrl = artifact.getString("archive_download_url")
614:                     break
615:                 }
616:             }
617:             val url = downloadUrl ?: return null
618:             val zipResponse = githubDownload(token, url)
619:             if (zipResponse.code !in 200..299 || zipResponse.body.isEmpty()) return null
620:             var endpointJson: String? = null
621:             ZipInputStream(zipResponse.body.inputStream()).use { zis ->
622:                 var entry = zis.nextEntry
623:                 while (entry != null) {
624:                     if (entry.name == "endpoint.json") {
625:                         endpointJson = zis.readBytes().toString(Charsets.UTF_8)
626:                         break
627:                     }
628:                     entry = zis.nextEntry
629:                 }
630:             }
631:             val endpoint = JSONObject(endpointJson ?: return null)
632:             Triple(
633:                 endpoint.getString("url"),
634:                 endpoint.getString("api_key"),
635:                 endpoint.optString("terminal"),
636:             )
637:         }.getOrNull()
638:     }

640:     /** Чат с ранером: OpenAI-совместимый endpoint llama.cpp. */
641:     suspend fun chat(context: Context, session: Session, userText: String): String? =
642:         withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
643:             val url = session.url ?: return@withContext null
644:             val key = session.apiKey ?: return@withContext null
645:             // Запрос строится из КОПИИ истории: мутация session.messages
646:             // происходит только при успешном ответе, поэтому при сбое сети в
647:             // сессию не попадает «фантомная» копия вопроса, а диалог не
648:             // расходится с тем, что реально ушло в ранер.
649:             val messages = JSONArray()
650:             (ArrayList(session.messages) + ("user" to userText)).takeLast(24).forEach { (r, c) ->
651:                 messages.put(JSONObject().put("role", r).put("content", c))
652:             }
653:             val answer = runCatching {
654:                 // Туннель cloudflared тоже может требовать прокси (как chat.try.ai).
655:                 val conn = AiAssistant.openConnection("$url/v1/chat/completions") as HttpURLConnection
656:                 conn.requestMethod = "POST"
657:                 conn.doOutput = true
658:                 conn.connectTimeout = 20_000
659:                 conn.readTimeout = 180_000
660:                 conn.setRequestProperty("Content-Type", "application/json")
661:                 conn.setRequestProperty("Authorization", "Bearer $key")
662:                 val body = JSONObject()
663:                     .put("model", session.model)
664:                     .put("messages", messages)
665:                     .put("max_tokens", 800)
666:                 conn.outputStream.use { it.write(body.toString().toByteArray()) }
667:                 val text = (if (conn.responseCode in 200..299) conn.inputStream else conn.errorStream)
668:                     ?.use { it.readBytes().toString(Charsets.UTF_8) }.orEmpty()
669:                 conn.disconnect()
670:                 JSONObject(text).optJSONArray("choices")?.optJSONObject(0)
671:                     ?.optJSONObject("message")?.optString("content")?.trim()
672:             }.onFailure {
673:                 logcat(LogPriority.WARN, it) { "Runner LLM chat failed" }
674:             }.getOrNull()
675:             if (answer != null) {
676:                 synchronized(session.messages) {
677:                     session.messages += "user" to userText
678:                     session.messages += "assistant" to answer
679:                 }
680:                 saveSession(context, session)
681:             }
682:             answer
683:         }

685:     /** Жива ли сессия (реальный запрос /health к туннелю). */
686:     suspend fun isAlive(session: Session): Boolean = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
687:         val url = session.url ?: return@withContext false
688:         runCatching {
689:             val conn = AiAssistant.openConnection("$url/health") as HttpURLConnection
690:             conn.connectTimeout = 8_000
691:             conn.readTimeout = 8_000
692:             session.apiKey?.let { conn.setRequestProperty("Authorization", "Bearer $it") }
693:             val ok = conn.responseCode in 200..299
694:             conn.disconnect()
695:             ok
696:         }.getOrDefault(false)
697:     }
698: 
699:     /** Статус ранера для индикации в UI. */
700:     data class RunnerStatus(
701:         val alive: Boolean,
702:         /** Аптайм сессии, мс (от createdAt). */
703:         val uptimeMs: Long,
704:         /** Осталось до 5.5-часового лимита job, мс. */
705:         val remainingMs: Long,
706:         /** Время последней проверки. */
707:         val checkedAt: Long,
708:     )

710:     private const val SESSION_LIFETIME_MS = 330L * 60_000L // 5.5 часов
711: 
712:     /**
713:      * ИНДИКАЦИЯ РАНЕРА (по требованию пользователя): живой /health-пинг +
714:      * аптайм + сколько осталось до конца сессии.
715:      */
716:     suspend fun status(session: Session): RunnerStatus {
717:         val alive = isAlive(session)
718:         val uptime = System.currentTimeMillis() - session.createdAt
719:         return RunnerStatus(
720:             alive = alive,
721:             uptimeMs = uptime,
722:             remainingMs = (SESSION_LIFETIME_MS - uptime).coerceAtLeast(0),
723:             checkedAt = System.currentTimeMillis(),
724:         )
725:     }

727:     /**

729:      * скачает её вместо каталожной. Размер неизвестен заранее — воркфлоу
730:      * напишет его в лог, а стартовый статус покажет прогресс этапов.
731:      */
732:     suspend fun startSessionWithUrl(
733:         context: Context,
734:         ggufUrl: String,
735:         onStatus: (String) -> Unit,
736:         os: String = "linux",
737:     ): Session? = startSessionInternal(context, "custom", ggufUrl, onStatus, os)
738: 
739:     /**
740:      * Запуск сессии OpenCode-агента (workflow opencode.yml): на GitHub-ранере
741:      * поднимаются opencode serve + oc-gateway (веб/мобильный чат) и npm-hub
742:      * (xterm-терминал, файлы, логи, git status/diff/log), всё открывается
743:      * cloudflared-туннелями. endpoint-артефакт несёт два адреса:
744:      *   url       — чат с агентом (oc-gateway);
745:      *   terminal  — npm-hub (терминал/файлы/дашборд).
746:      * Агент работает PAT-ом аккаунта (YP_AGENT_TOKEN), поэтому видит и меняет
747:      * ВСЕ репозитории, коммиты и логи аккаунта, а не только этот репозиторий.
748:      */
749:     suspend fun startOpenCode(
750:         context: Context,
751:         onStatus: (String) -> Unit,
752:         os: String = "linux",
753:         ui: String = "mobile",
754:         branch: String = "opencode-work",
755:     ): Session? = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
756:         val token = prefs().githubPat().get()
757:         if (token.isBlank()) {
758:             onStatus("Нет GitHub-токена: задайте PAT в настройках выше")
759:             return@withContext null
760:         }
761:         val selectedOs = if (os == "windows") "windows" else "linux"
762:         val session = Session(
763:             id = "oc" + System.currentTimeMillis().toString(36) + (1000..9999).random(),
764:             model = "hub",
765:             os = selectedOs,
766:         )
767: 
768:         onStatus("Отправляем запуск OpenCode в GitHub Actions…")
769:         val dispatchBody = JSONObject()
770:             .put("ref", OPENCODE_REF)
771:             .put(
772:                 "inputs",
773:                 JSONObject()
774:                     .put("session", session.id)
775:                     .put("os", selectedOs)
776:                     .put("ui", ui)
777:                     .put("branch", branch),
778:             )
779:         val dispatch = runCatching {
780:             githubRequest(
781:                 token = token,
782:                 url = "https://api.github.com/repos/$REPO/actions/workflows/$WORKFLOW_OPENCODE/dispatches",
783:                 method = "POST",
784:                 body = dispatchBody.toString(),
785:             )
786:         }.getOrElse {
787:             onStatus("Не удалось связаться с GitHub: ${it.message ?: "ошибка сети"}")
788:             return@withContext null
789:         }
790:         if (dispatch.code !in 200..299) {
791:             onStatus("GitHub отклонил запуск (${dispatch.code}): ${apiError(dispatch.body)}")
792:             return@withContext null
793:         }
794: 
795:         val deadline = System.currentTimeMillis() + START_TIMEOUT_MS
796:         var lastStatus = ""
797:         var runId: Long? = null
798:         while (System.currentTimeMillis() < deadline) {
799:             val state = fetchRunState(
800:                 token, session.id, selectedOs,
801:                 workflow = WORKFLOW_OPENCODE, stepText = ::opencodeStepText,
802:             )
803:             runId = state.runId ?: runId
804:             if (state.message != lastStatus) {
805:                 onStatus(state.message)
806:                 lastStatus = state.message
807:             }
808: 
809:             runId?.let { id ->
810:                 fetchEndpointArtifact(token, id, session.id)?.let { endpoint ->
811:                     session.url = endpoint.first
812:                     session.apiKey = endpoint.second
813:                     session.terminalUrl = endpoint.third.ifBlank { null }
814:                     saveSession(context, session)
815:                     onStatus("✅ OpenCode-агент готов: ${endpoint.first}")
816:                     return@withContext session
817:                 }
818:             }
819: 
820:             if (state.terminal) {
821:                 onStatus(state.message)
822:                 return@withContext null
823:             }
824:             delay(POLL_INTERVAL_MS)
825:         }
826:         onStatus(
827:             if (runId == null) {
828:                 "Таймаут: GitHub не создал запуск за ${START_TIMEOUT_MS / 60_000} минут"
829:             } else {
830:                 "Таймаут: endpoint не появился за ${START_TIMEOUT_MS / 60_000} минут. " +
831:                     "Последний статус: ${lastStatus.ifBlank { "неизвестен" }}"
832:             },
833:         )
834:         null
835:     }

13:     /** Что известно по последним попыткам. */
14:     enum class State {
15:         /** Ещё не пробовали — доказывать нечего. */

19:         WORKING,

37:

Findings from RunnerLlm:
- `Session.terminalUrl` exposes a ttyd web terminal in a public cloudflared tunnel with a session key — security-relevant. And `startOpenCode` comment (line 746-747) explicitly says the agent works with the account PAT and "видит и меняет ВСЕ репозитории" — i.e., a full-account takeover risk if the tunnel URL leaks. And the endpoint is published as a GitHub Actions *artifact* — artifacts can be downloaded by anyone with repo read access; and the api_key is stored in session file. Also `saveSession` writes `apiKey` to `files/llm_sessions/*.json` in plaintext (private storage, so acceptable-ish).
- `RunnerLlm.fetchVideoArtifact` (lines 330-369): `File.createTempFile` for the mp4 — creates in `java.io.tmpdir` which on Android is the app cache; not moved to workspace, so the file may be invisible/unreachable by the user and cleaned. Also `zis.readBytes()` reads whole mp4 into memory. Also there's no `zipSlip` check but they only accept `.mp4` and write to createTempFile so safe.
- `githubDownload` (line 419): `conn.setRequestProperty("Authorization", ...)` only for api.github.com — good. But note redirect to arbitrary external host controlled by GitHub response; acceptable.
- `githubRequest` (line 396): `AiAssistant.openConnection(url) as HttpURLConnection` — if the proxy returns something else, ClassCastException; but no runCatching around the cast in `githubRequest` (only in callers). Actually `startSessionInternal` wraps in runCatching. `fetchRunState` wraps. OK.
- `RunnerLlm.WORKFLOW_OPENCODE` ref is `main`, but comment lines 60-62 says agent/ etc. live in branch `prototype-opencode-agent`. Dispatch ref is `main` for opencode (`OPENCODE_REF = "main"`, line 63) — consistent.
- `GGUF_MODELS` (49-54) sizes: are they used anywhere? Need to check UI.
- `startSessionWithUrl` passes `modelKey = "custom"`.
- `opencodeStepText`/`llmStepText` used.
- `apiError` fine.

ZenAvailability: `describe` returns `true to "OK (не проверено, нужен интернет)"` for UNKNOWN — contradicts the comment "не обещаем". Minor. Actually it says available=true, which is a lie-ish; but they say "возможно честнее". Eh.

Now read remaining: ZenProtocol, DocExporter, ReaderAiActions, ReaderBookLookup, AiWorkspacePaths, AiWorkspaceSurvey, BookKnowledge, BookLearning, BookSharedMemory, BookChatProfile.

88:         }
89:         val userMessage = { value: String ->
90:             buildJsonObject {
91:                 put("role", "user")
92:                 put("content", value)
93:             }
94:         }
95:         return when (familyOf(model)) {
96:             // У Anthropic system — отдельное поле, а не сообщение в массиве.
97:             Family.MESSAGES -> buildJsonObject {
98:                 put("model", model)
99:                 put("max_tokens", limit)
100:                 put("system", system)
101:                 put("messages", JsonArray(listOf(userMessage(userPrompt))))
102:             }
103:             // У Gemini системная инструкция отдельная, ответ приходит в
104:             // candidates[].content.parts[].
105:             Family.GEMINI -> buildJsonObject {
106:                 put(
107:                     "contents",
108:                     JsonArray(
109:                         listOf(
110:                             buildJsonObject { put("parts", JsonArray(listOf(part(userPrompt)))) },
111:                         ),
112:                     ),
113:                 )
114:                 if (system.isNotBlank()) {
115:                     put(
116:                         "systemInstruction",
117:                         buildJsonObject { put("parts", JsonArray(listOf(part(system)))) },
118:                     )
119:                 }
120:                 put("generationConfig", buildJsonObject { put("maxOutputTokens", limit) })
121:             }
122:             // У Responses API инструкции отдельным полем, а не сообщением.
123:             Family.RESPONSES -> buildJsonObject {
124:                 put("model", model)
125:                 if (system.isNotBlank()) put("instructions", system)
126:                 put("input", JsonArray(listOf(userMessage(userPrompt))))
127:                 put("max_output_tokens", limit)
128:             }
129:             else -> buildJsonObject {
130:                 put("model", model)
131:                 val messages = buildList {
132:                     if (system.isNotBlank()) {
133:                         add(
134:                             buildJsonObject {
135:                                 put("role", "system")
136:                                 put("content", system)
137:                             },
138:                         )
139:                     }
140:                     add(userMessage(userPrompt))
141:                 }
142:                 put("messages", JsonArray(messages))
143:                 put("max_tokens", limit)
144:                 put("stream", false)
145:             }
146:         }
147:     }
148: 
149:     /** Разобранный ответ модели. */
150:     data class Parsed(
151:         val content: String?,
152:         val reasoning: String?,
153:         val tokens: Int,
154:         val complete: Boolean,
155:     )
156: 
157:     /**
158:      * Текст в поле, которое может оказаться пустым.
159:      *
160:      * Отдельно отсекается строка "null": провайдеры шлют её и как JSON null, и
161:      * как обычную строку, а читатель видел в чате «🤔 null» вместо ответа.
162:      */
163:     fun textOrNull(element: JsonElement?): String? {
164:         val raw = (element as? JsonPrimitive)?.contentOrNull ?: return null
165:         val t = raw.trim()
166:         return t.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() && !it.equals("null", ignoreCase = true) }
167:     }
168: 
169:     /**
170:      * Разбор ответа любого из известных форматов. У каждой формы свои ключи,
171:      * не пересекающиеся с остальными, поэтому явная ветка по семейству читается
172:      * проще, чем поиск «какая форма пришла».
173:      */
174:     fun parse(body: String, model: String): Parsed {
175:         val root = runCatching { json.parseToJsonElement(body) as? JsonObject }.getOrNull()
176:             ?: return Parsed(null, null, 0, true)
177:         return when (familyOf(model)) {
178:             Family.CHAT -> parseChat(root)
179:             Family.RESPONSES -> parseResponses(root)
180:             Family.MESSAGES -> parseMessages(root)
181:             Family.GEMINI -> parseGemini(root)
182:             // Jev не чат: у него нет ни текста, ни размышлений.
183:             Family.SYSTEM_ONE -> Parsed(null, null, 0, true)
184:         }
185:     }
186: 
187:     private fun JsonObject.str(key: String): String? = textOrNull(this[key])
188: 
189:     private fun JsonObject.int(key: String): Int = (this[key] as? JsonPrimitive)?.intOrNull ?: 0
190: 
191:     private fun JsonObject.flag(key: String): Boolean =
192:         (this[key] as? JsonPrimitive)?.booleanOrNull ?: false
193: 
194:     private fun JsonObject.array(key: String): List<JsonElement> = this[key] as? JsonArray ?: emptyList()
195: 
196:     private fun JsonObject.obj(key: String): JsonObject? = this[key] as? JsonObject
197: 
198:     private fun JsonObject.firstObject(key: String): JsonObject? = array(key).firstOrNull() as? JsonObject
199: 
200:     private fun join(vararg parts: StringBuilder): String? =
201:         parts.joinToString("") { it.toString() }
202:             .trim()
203:             .takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
204: 
205:     private fun StringBuilder.add(value: String?) {
206:         if (!value.isNullOrBlank()) append(value)
207:     }
208: 
209:     private fun parseChat(root: JsonObject): Parsed {
210:         val choice = root.firstObject("choices")
211:         val message = choice?.obj("message")
212:         val finish = choice?.str("finish_reason").orEmpty()
213:         return Parsed(
214:             content = message?.str("content"),
215:             // nemotron отдаёт «reasoning», hy3 — «reasoning_content».
216:             reasoning = message?.str("reasoning")
217:                 ?: message?.str("reasoning_content")
218:                 ?: root.str("reasoning"),
219:             tokens = root.obj("usage")?.int("total_tokens") ?: 0,
220:             complete = finish != "length",
221:         )
222:     }
223: 
224:     private fun parseResponses(root: JsonObject): Parsed {
225:         val content = StringBuilder()
226:         val reasoning = StringBuilder()
227:         for (item in root.array("output")) {
228:             val obj = item as? JsonObject ?: continue
229:             when (obj.str("type")) {
230:                 // Размышления приходят отдельным типом, текстом или списком.
231:                 "reasoning" -> {
232:                     reasoning.add(obj.str("text"))
233:                     for (part in obj.array("summary")) {
234:                         reasoning.add((part as? JsonObject)?.str("text"))
235:                     }
236:                 }
237:                 "message" -> {
238:                     for (part in obj.array("content")) {
239:                         content.add((part as? JsonObject)?.str("text"))
240:                     }
241:                 }
242:             }
243:         }
244:         return Parsed(
245:             content = join(content) ?: root.str("output_text"),
246:             reasoning = join(reasoning) ?: root.str("reasoning"),
247:             tokens = root.obj("usage")?.int("total_tokens") ?: 0,
248:             complete = root.str("status")?.lowercase() != "incomplete",
249:         )
250:     }
251: 
252:     private fun parseMessages(root: JsonObject): Parsed {
253:         val content = StringBuilder()
254:         val reasoning = StringBuilder()
255:         for (block in root.array("content")) {
256:             val b = block as? JsonObject ?: continue
257:             when (b.str("type")) {
258:                 "text" -> content.add(b.str("text"))
259:                 // Claude отдаёт размышления отдельным блоком thinking.
260:                 "thinking", "redacted_thinking" -> reasoning.add(b.str("thinking"))
261:             }
262:         }
263:         val usage = root.obj("usage")
264:         return Parsed(
265:             content = join(content),
266:             reasoning = join(reasoning),
267:             tokens = (usage?.int("input_tokens") ?: 0) + (usage?.int("output_tokens") ?: 0),
268:             complete = root.str("stop_reason")?.lowercase() != "max_tokens",
269:         )
270:     }
271: 
272:     private fun parseGemini(root: JsonObject): Parsed {
273:         val candidate = root.firstObject("candidates")
274:         val parts = candidate?.obj("content")?.array("parts").orEmpty()
275:         val content = StringBuilder()
276:         val reasoning = StringBuilder()
277:         for (part in parts) {
278:             val p = part as? JsonObject ?: continue
279:             val t = p.str("text") ?: continue
280:             // Размышления помечены флагом thought у самой части текста.
281:             if (p.flag("thought")) reasoning.add(t) else content.add(t)
282:         }
283:         return Parsed(
284:             content = join(content),
285:             reasoning = join(reasoning),
286:             tokens = root.obj("usageMetadata")?.int("totalTokenCount") ?: 0,
287:             complete = candidate?.str("finishReason")?.uppercase() != "MAX_TOKENS",
288:         )
289:     }
290: }

17: /**
18:  * Экспорт сообщений чата в документы БЕЗ внешних библиотек:
19:  *
20:  * • PDF — системный android.graphics.pdf.PdfDocument: текст с переносами
21:  *   (StaticLayout) и картинки, многостраничный A4.
22:  * • DOCX — это zip с OOXML-файлами; собирается вручную (ZipOutputStream):
23:  *   [Content_Types].xml + document.xml + relationships + media/…jpg.
24:  *   Открывается Word/WPS/Google Docs — проверенная минимальная структура.
25:  *
26:  * Правило (по требованию пользователя): текст без картинок -> и PDF и DOCX
27:  * доступны; если среди выделенных сообщений есть картинка — экспорт идёт
28:  * в DOCX или PDF (не в plain text).
29:  */
30: object DocExporter {
31: 
32:     data class Item(val title: String, val text: String, val imagePath: String?)
33: 
34:     // ---------- PDF ----------
35: 
36:     fun exportPdf(context: Context, items: List<Item>, fileName: String): File {
37:         val doc = PdfDocument()
38:         val pageW = 595 // A4 @72dpi
39:         val pageH = 842
40:         val margin = 40f
41:         val contentW = (pageW - margin * 2).toInt()
42: 
43:         val titlePaint = TextPaint().apply {
44:             color = Color.BLACK; textSize = 13f; isFakeBoldText = true; isAntiAlias = true
45:         }
46:         val textPaint = TextPaint().apply {
47:             color = Color.DKGRAY; textSize = 11f; isAntiAlias = true
48:         }
49: 
50:         var page = doc.startPage(PdfDocument.PageInfo.Builder(pageW, pageH, doc.pages.size + 1).create())
51:         var canvas = page.canvas
52:         var y = margin
53: 
54:         fun newPage() {
55:             doc.finishPage(page)
56:             page = doc.startPage(PdfDocument.PageInfo.Builder(pageW, pageH, doc.pages.size + 1).create())
57:             canvas = page.canvas
58:             y = margin
59:         }
60: 
61:         fun drawText(paint: TextPaint, text: String) {
62:             if (text.isBlank()) return
63:             val layout = StaticLayout.Builder.obtain(text, 0, text.length, paint, contentW)
64:                 .setAlignment(Layout.Alignment.ALIGN_NORMAL).setLineSpacing(2f, 1f).build()
65:             var line = 0
66:             while (line < layout.lineCount) {
67:                 val lineBottom = layout.getLineBottom(line) - layout.getLineTop(line)
68:                 if (y + lineBottom > pageH - margin) newPage()
69:                 // Рисуем построчно, чтобы уметь переносить через страницы
70:                 val start = layout.getLineStart(line)
71:                 val end = layout.getLineEnd(line)
72:                 canvas.drawText(text.substring(start, end).trimEnd(), margin, y + paint.textSize, paint)
73:                 y += lineBottom
74:                 line++
75:             }
76:             y += 6f
77:         }
78: 
79:         for (item in items) {
80:             drawText(titlePaint, item.title)
81:             drawText(textPaint, item.text)
82:             val img = item.imagePath?.let { BitmapFactory.decodeFile(it) }
83:             if (img != null) {
84:                 val scale = minOf(contentW.toFloat() / img.width, 1f)
85:                 val w = (img.width * scale).toInt()
86:                 val h = (img.height * scale).toInt()
87:                 if (y + h > pageH - margin) newPage()
88:                 val scaled = if (scale < 1f) Bitmap.createScaledBitmap(img, w, h, true) else img
89:                 canvas.drawBitmap(scaled, margin, y, Paint(Paint.FILTER_BITMAP_FLAG))
90:                 y += h + 10f
91:                 if (scaled !== img) scaled.recycle()
92:                 img.recycle()
93:             }
94:             y += 8f
95:         }
96:         doc.finishPage(page)
97: 
98:         val out = File(File(AiWorkspace.root(context), "export"), fileName).apply { parentFile?.mkdirs() }
99:         out.outputStream().use { doc.writeTo(it) }
100:         doc.close()
101:         return out
102:     }
103: 
104:     // ---------- DOCX (минимальный валидный OOXML) ----------
105: 
106:     fun exportDocx(context: Context, items: List<Item>, fileName: String): File {
107:         val out = File(File(AiWorkspace.root(context), "export"), fileName).apply { parentFile?.mkdirs() }
108:         val images = items.mapIndexedNotNull { i, item ->
109:             item.imagePath?.let { path -> Triple(i, "image${i + 1}.jpg", path) }
110:         }
111: 
112:         ZipOutputStream(out.outputStream()).use { zip ->
113:             fun put(name: String, content: ByteArray) {
114:                 zip.putNextEntry(ZipEntry(name))
115:                 zip.write(content)
116:                 zip.closeEntry()
117:             }
118:             fun put(name: String, content: String) = put(name, content.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8))
119: 
120:             val imageTypes = if (images.isEmpty()) "" else
121:                 """<Default Extension="jpg" ContentType="image/jpeg"/><Default Extension="jpeg" ContentType="image/jpeg"/>"""
122:             put(
123:                 "[Content_Types].xml",

127: <Default Extension="xml" ContentType="application/xml"/>$imageTypes
128: <Override PartName="/word/document.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document.main+xml"/>
129: </Types>""",
130:             )
131:             put(
132:                 "_rels/.rels",
133:                 """<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
134: <Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships">
135: <Relationship Id="rId1" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/officeDocument" Target="word/document.xml"/>
136: </Relationships>""",
137:             )

139:                 """<Relationship Id="rImg$i" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/image" Target="media/$name"/>"""
140:             }

143:                 """<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>

147:             val body = StringBuilder()

149:                 body.append("<w:p><w:pPr><w:rPr><w:b/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r><w:rPr><w:b/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space=\"preserve\">")
150:                     .append(xmlEscape(item.title)).append("</w:t></w:r></w:p>")
151:                 item.text.lines().forEach { line ->
152:                     body.append("<w:p><w:r><w:t xml:space=\"preserve\">")
153:                         .append(xmlEscape(line)).append("</w:t></w:r></w:p>")
154:                 }
155:                 val img = images.firstOrNull { it.first == idx }
156:                 if (img != null) {
157:                     val bmp = BitmapFactory.decodeFile(img.third)
158:                     if (bmp != null) {
159:                         // EMU: 9525 на пиксель; ограничиваем ширину 15 см
160:                         val maxW = 5_400_000L
161:                         var wEmu = bmp.width * 9525L
162:                         var hEmu = bmp.height * 9525L

170:                         )
171:                     }
172:                 }
173:             }
174:             put(
175:                 "word/document.xml",
176:                 """<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
177: <w:document xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main"><w:body>$body<w:sectPr/></w:body></w:document>""",

184:                 zip.closeEntry()
185:                 bmp.recycle()

/**
 * Как ассистент работает с ЭТОЙ книгой: три настройки, которые читатель
 * переключает прямо в чате читалки.
 *
 *  * [MODE_CHAT] — обычный помощник: отвечает по книге, ищет источники, ведёт
 *    дела. То, что было по умолчанию.
 *  * [MODE_ROLEPLAY] — «дружеская встреча»: ассистент отыгрывает героев и
 *    общается вместо справочного тона. Знания книги при этом не теряются —
 *    режим меняет тон, а не память.
 *  * [MATURE_ALLOWED] — для книг 18+ ассистент может обсуждать зрелые темы.
 *    Для остальных книг запрет остаётся жёстким.
 *  * [CENSORSHIP_ON] — фильтр грубых слов в ответе. Это косметика для
 *    спокойного чтения, а не фильтр содержания: грубые слова маскируются
 *    звёздочками, смысл ответа не меняется.
 *
 * Жёсткая граница, которую нельзя переключить: никакого сексуального
 * контента с несовершеннолетними, никаких отыгрышей реальных людей и
 * никакого сексуального насилия. Это не настройка, а правило ассистента.

import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable

 */
object BookLearning {

    const val KIND_SITE = "site"
    const val KIND_SUMMARY = "summary"
    const val KIND_FACT = "fact"
    const val KIND_ADVICE = "advice"
    const val KIND_READING_ORDER = "reading_order"
    const val KIND_REGION = "region"
    const val KIND_BUBBLE = "bubble"
    const val KIND_TRANSCRIPTION = "transcription"
    const val KIND_VOICE = "voice"
    const val KIND_NOTE = "note"

    const val AUTHOR_USER = "user"
    const val AUTHOR_WEB = "web"
    const val AUTHOR_AGENT = "agent"

    const val MAX_TEXT_CHARS = 6000

    /** Источник длиннее этого в промпт не идёт: ссылка должна быть читаемой. */
    const val MAX_SOURCE_CHARS = 300

    val KINDS: List<String> = listOf(
        KIND_SITE,
        KIND_SUMMARY,
        KIND_FACT,
        KIND_ADVICE,
        KIND_READING_ORDER,
        KIND_REGION,
        KIND_BUBBLE,
        KIND_TRANSCRIPTION,
        KIND_VOICE,
        KIND_NOTE,
    )

        "site" to KIND_SITE,
        "url" to KIND_SITE,
        "где читать" to KIND_SITE,
        "сайт" to KIND_SITE,
        "summary" to KIND_SUMMARY,
        "сюжет" to KIND_SUMMARY,
        "о чём" to KIND_SUMMARY,
        "fact" to KIND_FACT,
        "факт" to KIND_FACT,
        "advice" to KIND_ADVICE,
        "совет" to KIND_ADVICE,
        "reading_order" to KIND_READING_ORDER,
        "reading order" to KIND_READING_ORDER,
        "порядок" to KIND_READING_ORDER,

        "region" to KIND_REGION,
        "область" to KIND_REGION,

        "bubble" to KIND_BUBBLE,
        "бабл" to KIND_BUBBLE,
        "баблы" to KIND_BUBBLE,
        "облачко" to KIND_BUBBLE,
        "облачка" to KIND_BUBBLE,
        "облачки" to KIND_BUBBLE,

        "transcription" to KIND_TRANSCRIPTION,

        "голос" to KIND_VOICE,

        KIND_TRANSCRIPTION -> "Расшифровка"
        KIND_VOICE -> "Голоса и роли"
        else -> "Заметка"
    }

    private val toolCallBlock = Regex("<[^>]*tool_call[^>]*>.*?</[^>]*tool_call>", RegexOption.DOT_MATCHES_ALL)
    private val toolCallLine = Regex("^@\\s*(?:tool\\s+)?[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\\s*\\{")
    private val controlChars = Regex("[\\u0000-\\u0008\\u000B\\u000C\\u000E-\\u001F\\u007F]")

    /**
     * Очищает текст из внешнего источника: убирает управляющие символы,
     * вызовы инструментов (чужой текст не должен уметь вызывать @tool),
     * схлопывает пустые строки и обрезает по [maxChars].
     */
    fun sanitize(raw: String, maxChars: Int = MAX_TEXT_CHARS): String {
        val limit = maxChars.coerceIn(64, 40_000)
        val withoutCalls = toolCallBlock.replace(raw, " ")
        val lines = withoutCalls
            .split('\n')
            .map { controlChars.replace(it, " ").trim() }
            .filterNot { toolCallLine.containsMatchIn(it) }
        val kept = mutableListOf<String>()
        var pendingBreak = false
        for (line in lines) {
            if (line.isBlank()) {
                pendingBreak = kept.isNotEmpty()
                continue
            }
            if (pendingBreak) kept.add("")
            pendingBreak = false
            kept.add(line)
        }
        val text = kept.joinToString("\n")
        return if (text.length <= limit) text else text.take(limit).trimEnd() + "…"
    }

    private val bullet = Regex("^(?:(?:[-*•–—]|\\d{1,3}[.)])\\s*)+")

    /**
     * Разбирает присланный текст на правила. Список («- …», «1. …») становится
     * несколькими правилами, обычный текст — одним правилом целиком.
     */
    fun parseRules(
        raw: String,
        kind: String = KIND_NOTE,
        source: String = "",
        author: String = AUTHOR_AGENT,
        time: Long = System.currentTimeMillis(),
        maxRules: Int = 12,
    ): List<LearningRule> {
        val clean = sanitize(raw)
        if (clean.isBlank()) return emptyList()
        val normalized = normalizeKind(kind)
        val bullets = clean.lines().map { it.trim() }.filter { bullet.containsMatchIn(it) }
        val texts = if (bullets.isEmpty()) {
            listOf(clean)
        } else {
            bullets.map { it.replace(bullet, "").trim() }.filter { it.isNotEmpty() }
        }
        val perRule = (MAX_TEXT_CHARS / texts.size.coerceAtLeast(1)).coerceIn(200, MAX_TEXT_CHARS)
        return texts.take(maxRules.coerceIn(1, 40)).map {
            LearningRule(
                kind = normalized,
                text = sanitize(it, perRule),
                source = source,
                author = author,
                time = time,
            )
        }.filter { it.text.isNotBlank() }
    }

    /**
     * Порядок чтения из правила книги: правило может быть «сверху вниз»,
     * «справа налево», «vertical», «rtl»… Возвращает только известные движку
     * значения, иначе null — тогда остаётся порядок из пресета контента.
     */
    fun readingOrderOf(text: String): String? {
        val t = text.trim().lowercase()
        return when {
            t.isEmpty() -> null
            "vertical" in t || "сверху вниз" in t || "сверху-вниз" in t || " сверху" in t -> "vertical"
            "справа налево" in t || "right to left" in t || t.startsWith("rtl") -> "rtl"
            "слева направо" in t || "left to right" in t || t.startsWith("ltr") -> "ltr"
            else -> null
        }
    }

    /** Правило одного вида — последнее выученное (правила переопределяют друг друга). */
    fun lastOf(rules: List<LearningRule>, kind: String): LearningRule? {
        val target = normalizeKind(kind)
        return rules.lastOrNull { it.kind == target }
    }

    private val urlScheme = Regex("^(https?)://([^/\\s?#]+)", RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE)

    /**
     * Источник пригоден, если это обычная веб-ссылка. Агент не должен уводить
     * приложение читать `file://`, `content://` или `javascript:` — поэтому
     * проверка схемы и хоста здесь, а не внутри загрузчика.
     */
    fun isHttpUrl(raw: String): Boolean {
        val url = raw.trim()
        if (url.isEmpty() || url.length > MAX_SOURCE_CHARS * 8) return false
        val match = urlScheme.find(url) ?: return false
        val authority = match.groupValues[2]
        return authority.isNotBlank() && !authority.startsWith(':') && !authority.endsWith(':')
    }

    /**
     * Источник в том виде, в каком он попадёт в промпт: одна строка без
     * управляющих символов. Ссылка приходит извне, поэтому длинный «url» с
     * переводом строки и инструкцией внутри не должен ломать разметку блока
     * правил и не должен печататься целиком.
     */
    fun normalizeSource(raw: String): String =
        sanitize(raw, MAX_SOURCE_CHARS).replace(Regex("\\s+"), " ").trim()
}

package eu.kanade.tachiyomi.data.ai

/**
 * Чистые вспомогательные функции workspace — без `Context`, без файловой
 * системы, без Android. Вынесены из [AiWorkspace] именно потому, что их можно
 * проверить обычными unit-тестами на JVM: это защита от выхода за пределы
 * workspace и от `ZipException("duplicate entry")`.
 */
object AiWorkspacePaths {

    private val FORBIDDEN = Regex("[\\\\:*?\"<>|]")

    /**
     * Приводит пользовательское имя к безопасному для файловой системы виду.
     * `..` вырезается, чтобы имя не могло вывести запись за пределы workspace:
     * проверка `canonicalPath` в [AiWorkspace.resolve] остаётся основным
     * барьером, но второй слой здесь ничего не стоит.
     */
    fun sanitize(name: String): String =
        name.replace(FORBIDDEN, "_").replace("..", "_").trim()

    /**
     * Уникальное имя zip-записи.
     *
     * `ZipOutputStream.putNextEntry` бросает `ZipException("duplicate entry")`,
     * если имя уже встречалось, и весь архив не собирается. Имена могут
     * совпасть, когда файлы из разных папок дают одинаковый относительный путь
     * (например, `relPath()` не смог вычислить префикс и вернул только имя).
     * Дубликат получает числовой суффикс перед расширением: `a.txt` → `a_1.txt`.
     *
     * Метод добавляет результат в [used] и возвращает его.
     */
    fun uniqueEntryName(candidate: String, used: MutableSet<String>): String {
        val base = candidate.ifBlank { "file" }
        if (used.add(base)) return base
        val dot = base.lastIndexOf('.')
        val stem = if (dot > 0) base.substring(0, dot) else base
        val ext = if (dot > 0) base.substring(dot) else ""
        var index = 1
        while (true) {
            val next = "${stem}_$index$ext"
            if (used.add(next)) return next
            index++
        }
    }
}

MAJOR finding: `AiChatTab` is NOT a chat UI at all. Despite the name "AiChatTab" and the earlier assumption, the global "AI" tab is only:
- GitHub PAT field
- "▶ Запустить" OpenCode runner launcher
- runner events feed
- session list
- WebView of npm-hub

There is no chat message list, no text input for chat, no `AiAgent.run()` call, no model picker, no settings gear. So the "AI tab" is essentially a launcher for the OpenCode runner. The actual chat lives in the reader overlay (`ReaderAiChatOverlay`). This contradicts the error messages in `AiAgent` which say "включите в ⚙ вкладки AI" — there is no ⚙ in the AI tab. This is a major incompleteness finding.

Also `AiChatTab` has a bug: `elapsed` is declared *inside* the `else` block (line 160) and used at line 212 — fine. But `LaunchedEffect(starting)` is inside a conditional block; fine.

Also the `HubWebView` handles `onReceivedHttpAuthRequest` by proceeding with `session.apiKey` for ANY host (no host check) — credential leak if the tunnel page loads third-party subresources requiring auth. Also `MIXED_CONTENT_ALWAYS_ALLOW` (line 340) plus JavaScript enabled + no `setAllowFileAccess` restrictions... Actually `WebSettings.setAllowFileAccess` defaults to true on older APIs, and `allowFileAccessFromFileURLs` defaults false. Mixed content always allow weakens transport security. Also no `setSafeBrowsingEnabled`. Also there's no check that the session URL is still alive.

Also, `AiChatTab` tab index is 9u; `options` provides title "AI".

Also: WebView is created in `remember(session.id, url)`; the `DisposableEffect` destroys it. OK.

Now let me look at ReaderAiChatOverlay — the real chat UI — and AiModelPickerDialog, and SettingsAiScreen. ReaderAiChatOverlay is 1267 lines. Let me read it in chunks.

Excellent — confirmed dead code:
- `AiSkills.openIntent` — never called (dead).
- `AiHistoryManager.trimToBudget` / `totalTokens` — never called (dead; so `pref_ai_token_budget` is unused too!). Let me verify aiTokenBudget usage.
- `AiWorkspace.delete` — never called from any UI/tool (dead) — no way for user to delete workspace files from the app.
- `RunnerLlm.status` / `isAlive` — `isAlive` is used by `status` only; `status` never called → dead (no runner liveness indicator despite comments).
- `RunnerLlm.GGUF_MODELS` — never used → the 4 GGUF model entries with sizes are dead; `startSession` is never called from UI either (only `startOpenCode`). Let me verify `startSession` and `startSessionWithUrl` and `startVideo` usage.
- `LocalLlm.exportTarXz`, `searchHuggingFace`, `customModels`, `modelFromUrl` — all never called → dead UI-less code; LocalLlm only used by AiBackends.
- `aiShowReasoning` / `aiShowAvailability` — dead prefs confirmed.
- `DocExporter` is used only by `ChapterOcrTranscript` (TTS), NOT by the AI chat — the KDoc says "экспорт сообщений чата" and "тот самый, что уже делает PDF/DOCX для AI-чата" but AI chat has no export. Incomplete.

parts.text:
Key findings from SettingsAiScreen:
1. Backend selection rows (lines 145-153) are `TextPreference` with **no `onClick`** — you cannot switch backends here at all. It only displays. The hint string `pref_ai_backend_switch_hint` presumably says "switch in AI tab ⚙" — but the AI tab has no switcher (AiChatTab has no backend switch; AiModelPickerDialog is in the reader only). So `pref_ai_backend` can ONLY be changed from the reader's `AiModelPickerDialog`. That's a real gap: backend switching is only reachable inside the reader.
2. No `aiAllowRunner` / `aiAllowGithub` switches → confirms dead toggles. Requirements `RUNNER_ALLOWED` are displayed but unfixable.
3. `getBackendsGroup` uses `AiBackends.ALL` (all 4 backends incl. local/runner) — status of runner always unavailable.
4. `AiProviders.list` is read but there is no UI to add/remove user providers (only `provider_create` agent tool). Consistent with the design.
5. KDoc says toggles live "в настройках вкладки AI (⚙)" — but no such ⚙ exists (AiChatTab has none). Documentation lie.
6. `aiBookLookup` has no preference item → not exposed.

# AI Functionality Audit — `/home/runner/hub-work/yomikai/code`

Read-only review. No files modified. Scope: `data/ai` package, reader AI UI, AI tab, AI settings, persistence, DI, tests, and cross-module references.

---

## P0 — Critical

### 1. `workspace_list` allows directory traversal outside the workspace
`app/src/main/java/eu/kanade/tachiyomi/data/ai/AiWorkspaceSurvey.kt:142-147` — `resolveDir` only checks `isDirectory`:

```kotlin
val dir = if (rawPath.isBlank()) root else File(root, rawPath)
if (!dir.isDirectory) return null
```

`AiAgent.kt:1569` (`workspace_list`) and `AiAgent.kt:1578` (`read_many` path base) pass the model's `path`/`name` straight through. `AiWorkspacePaths.sanitize` and `AiWorkspace.resolve` are the intended traversal defenses, but neither is used here. A model (or injected text) using `{"path":"../../.."}` enumerates any directory the app can read — names, sizes, `isDirectory`, and modified times — including `/sdcard/Android/data` and app-private `filesDir`. Exposure is bounded by Android scoped storage, but it is still a clear boundary violation, and it is reachable from a chat message.

### 2. AI chat history is written outside the workspace, and `zip_workspace`/workspace listing silently omit it
Two resolvers disagree:

- `AiWorkspace.kt:62-83` → prefers `Environment.getExternalStorageDirectory()/Yomikai/AI` = `/storage/emulated/0/Yomikai/AI`, fallback `getExternalFilesDir(null)/Yomikai/AI`.
- `AiHistoryManager.kt:78-84` → `File(getExternalFilesDir(null), "../../Yomikai/AI").canonicalFile` = **`/storage/emulated/0/Android/Yomikai/AI`**, a third path that matches neither.

`AiHistoryManager.historyFile` (`:70-76`) calls `aiWorkspaceDir`, so chat history lands in `…/Android/Yomikai/AI`. Consequences: the agent cannot see prior conversations through `workspace_list`/`read_file` (contradicting `AiAgent.kt:250-252`, "read the tail with `read_file` so context is not lost"), and `zip_workspace` (`AiAgent.kt:1600`) does not include history. The fallback only engages if the wrong path cannot be created, which is rarely.

### 3. Feature permissions have no writer — runner and GitHub tools are permanently disabled
`domain/src/main/java/mihon/domain/ocr/service/OcrPreferences.kt:281` (`aiAllowRunner`) and `:285` (`aiAllowGithub`), both default `false`. A repository-wide search for `.aiAllowRunner().set` / `.aiAllowGithub().set` found **no writer** in any module, preference screen, migration, or dialog.

Downstream:
- `AiAgent.kt:937-956` — `runner_chat`, `runner_start` and runner helpers are gated on `aiAllowRunner` → dead.
- `AiAgent.kt:970-973` — `github_api` gated on `aiAllowGithub` → dead; `repo_pulls` (`AiAgent.kt:1044`) and `runner_runs`/`runner_events` inherit the same block.
- `AiBackends.kt:194-203` — the runner backend reports `RUNNER_ALLOWED` as a missing requirement that the user can never satisfy.
- `AiChatTab` launches an OpenCode runner anyway, bypassing the gate entirely.
- The SYSTEM_PROMPT still advertises all six tools (`AiAgent.kt:257-266`), so the model is instructed to use tools that always return an error.

Either these are dead preferences that should be removed from the gating logic, or the missing switch must be added. As written the prompt/UI and runtime disagree.

### 4. Broken-thread-pool / main-thread disk and network I/O in Compose
`ReaderAiChatOverlay.kt:167-169` — `LaunchedEffect(Unit)` runs on `Dispatchers.Main.immediate` and calls `AiBackends.state(context, prefs)`, which performs `RunnerLlm.listSessions` (directory scan + JSON reads, `AiBackends.kt:345-350`), `LocalLlm.isInstalled` (stat), and `isNetworkAvailable` (ConnectivityManager binder).

`presentation/more/settings/screen/SettingsAiScreen.kt:56-57` does the same inside `remember(...)`, i.e. during composition, and `SettingsAiScreen.kt:65-67` additionally calls `AiPlugins.list(context)` and `AiWorkspace.listAll(context)` — a full recursive workspace walk capped at 5000 entries — on the main thread.

Both are StrictMode `DiskReadViolation`s and real jank/ANR risks on large workspaces or cold cache. The same file already gets it right at `ReaderAiChatOverlay.kt:1194-1196` (`withContext(Dispatchers.IO)`), which confirms the pattern was known and simply not applied in the two places above.

### 5. "Stop" does not stop the agent request
`ReaderAiChatOverlay.kt:151` declares `runningJob`; `:275-278` cancels it. No assignment exists anywhere — the `scope.launch` at `:712` discards its `Job`. The button therefore only invokes `onStopRequested()` (TTS/auto-read). A running `AiAgent.run` continues to completion, the Stop label stays misleading, and the user cannot cancel an in-flight request that may be executing file writes, `provider_create`, or `runner_start` on their behalf.
